summary: This procedure validates financial transactions against account status, card validity, and credit/cash limits. It returns a specific error code (R#) if the transaction fails any business rule, or 0 if the transaction is valid.

rules.text: If duplicate flag is set, return error 110.
If transaction amount is zero or negative, return error 109.
If transaction type is fee (KO_TYP_GEB) or interest (KO_TYP_ZINS), return error 111.
If transaction type is not one of the allowed types (KO_TYP_KAUF, KO_TYP_ZAHL, KO_TYP_GUT, KO_TYP_BAR), return error 111.
If the card lookup returns no index, return error 100.
If the card status is not 'Y', return error 101.
If the account lookup returns no index, return error 102.
If account status is 'C' or 'X', return error 103.
If the transaction date is after the card expiry date, return error 105.
If account status is 'D' and the debit flag is set, return error 104.
If transaction is a purchase and the MCC is a blocked MCC, return error 108.
If transaction is cash and exceeds the cash limit, return error 107.
If the debit flag is set, check if the new balance (current balance + transaction amount) exceeds the credit limit; if so, return error 106.
The rule checking if daily total exceeds daily limit was removed in 1999.
